sources: Hit structure: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0034_typhoea_* (game 1.6). Projectile and ability-entity hits take their parent's blackboard (LaunchProjectile / SpawnAbilityEntity assignBlackboard) and split it with SimpleCalcBBAction literals (operation 2 = ×, 3 = ÷), written here as `factor`: attack1 2 arrows × atk_scale/2; attack3 2 waves × atk_scale/2 (3 arrows per wave, one damages a target: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_attack_3_*_damagetaken gate); attack4 atk_scale×0.35 + 5 × atk_scale×0.13; battle skill 2 arrows × atk_scale×0.5; combo 7 arrows × atk_scale/7 and 18 ticks × atk_scale_persistent/18; ultimate follow-up rains 3 ticks × atk_scale_outer/3, final rain 5 × atk_scale_center×0.08 + atk_scale_center×0.6. Frames are launch frames (projectiles) or spawn frame + entity frame (ability entities).

Skill descriptions (CharGrowthTable + I18nTextTable_EN). Battle skill: "Typhoeus leaps into the air and enters a short Hovering state, during which she can unleash 5 Aerial Basic Attacks (ABATK) … Whenever an ABATK hits an enemy with Nature Infliction, it consumes 1 stack of Nature Infliction, grants Typhoeus 1 Sign, and gives additional Ultimate Energy. If Typhoeus has Hunting Arrow(s), she consumes 1 Hunting Arrow and converts the ABATK into a Power Shot. Power Shot: After hitting an enemy, Power Shot forcibly applies 1 instance of Nature Burst; if the Power Shot consumes the target's Nature Infliction, then increase the DMG dealt by this Nature Burst. If Typhoeus is the controlled operator, her 5th ABATK is regarded as a Final Strike and a Power Shot, and does not consume Hunting Arrows." Talent 1: "Whenever a Nature Burst is triggered on an enemy, Typhoeus gains 1 Sign. DMG dealt by attacks empowered by consuming Hunting Arrows is increased to {atk_scale_enhence} times the original. When entering battle, Typhoeus immediately gains {energy_enterfight} Sign(s). Typhoeus can have up to 4 Hunting Arrows and 8 Signs." Combo: "COMBO TRIGGER: When Typhoeus reaches max Signs. Typhoeus converts all her Signs to Hunting Arrows and resets her Aerial Basic Attack (ABATK) attempts … Enemies in the Barrage Array take Nature DMG over time, are slowed, and suffer increased Nature Burst DMG Taken. Every 2 Signs convert to 1 Hunting Arrow." Ultimate: "… She then enters a Hovering state and her Aerial Basic Attack (ABATK) attempts are reset. For her next 5 ABATKs, hitting an enemy triggers a Hail of Arrows … Casting the ultimate gives {arrow_num_given} Hunting Arrows immediately."

Power Shots (SkillData floating_attack1_01_projhit / floating_attack5_01_projhit, enhence_arrow branch): the arrow deals atk_scale_base × atk_scale_enhence, then creates his burst buff_common_natural_natural_triggered_typhoea = the standard Nature burst (ReadSkillSettingData 法术爆发伤害倍率) × damage_enhence, where damage_enhence = potential_damage_rate, × enchence_burst_damage_rate when the target had a Nature infliction (consumed: FinishBuffAdvanced 1 layer of the infliction tag, ObtainCostAction usp_recover, arrow_energy_buffer_2 = 1 Sign). Every Nature burst on an enemy gives her 1 Sign (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_passitive_enemy_listennaturalspellbrust, an aura on enemies listening for the burst tag of buff_common_natural_natural_triggered and of her own burst). The burst is logged ~0.33 s after the arrow; here it lands with the arrow.

Hunting Arrows (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_num, max 4) and Signs (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_energy, max 8) are kit stacks. The kit format can only use up a whole stack, so the arrows are four one-arrow stacks arrow_1–arrow_4: shot N of a hover (floating_attackN, N = 1–4) is a Power Shot if slot N is filled and uses it up. Shots spend arrows in order, so this counts like the game's 1 arrow per shot: a full hover (shots 1–4) spends all of them, and a combo or ultimate refills slots 1–4 / 1–2 (it differs only when a hover was cut short before the ultimate). The 5th shot is always a Power Shot. A shot without an arrow is a plain shot in the game (atk_scale_base, a Sign and usp_recover energy when it consumes Nature Infliction); the kit format can't give a hit a no-arrow variant, so such shots have no hit here. Start of battle: she gains energy_enterfight (talent 1: 4) Signs and, in the dungeon categories of buff_chr_0034_typhoea_passive_arrowrecover, 4 arrows; kit stacks start at 0.

Verification (efsim zmdlogs check, every hit with event keys within ±1): fixtures/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json (P1, no Corrosion) 35 of 43 Typhoeus hits match (battle-skill volley, floating shots, combo arrows and all 12 Barrage Array ticks, Hail of Arrows ticks); zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json (P5) 11 match, 14 under Corrosion; zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49.json (P5) 24 match (every grounded basic attack 1–5, the volley, floating shots and an array tick before Corrosion), 29 under Corrosion; zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json (parser v58, P0) 0 match, 35 under Corrosion. Not keyed: her bursts (buff_common_natural_natural_triggered_typhoea) and the ultimate's main hit, see their notes. d9e59 is short of a large unlogged buff on every Typhoeus hit (×1.54–1.9 after t=9605, ×1.1585 on the ultimate at t=4415).
Only ultimate_skillfloating is in CharGrowthTable's ultimate group (chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill is unused), so the ultimate always uses its values (atk_scale_outer 0.75 at level 12).

stacks.label: Signs
stacks.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_energy maxStackCnt 8; talent 1: "up to … 8 Signs". Reaching 8 opens the combo (the buff creates buff_chr_0034_typhoea_combo_trigger_combo at 8 stacks).

stacks.label: Hunting Arrow 1
stacks.note: Hunting Arrows (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_normal_skill_arrow_num maxStackCnt 4; talent 1: "up to 4 Hunting Arrows") as four one-arrow slots: the kit can only use up a whole stack, so shot N of a hover spends slot N. See sources.

buffs.label: Hovering (floating stance)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_floatingmode (BuffData duration 10 s; the 5th shot ends it at its frame 15, which the kit can't do, so the state lasts its full 10 s here). Created at frame 0 by the battle skill, the ultimate and the floating combo. Gates the floating shots and the floating combo.

buffs.label: Hovering ATK (P1)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_potential_atkup (ATK + atk_up; attributeType 2, formula item 6; BuffData duration 10 s, ended with the stance), created by the floating stance when the casting skill's potential_atkup is 1 (P1 sets it to 1 and atk_up to 0.18 on the battle skill and the ultimate). The value is min(atk_up, potential_atkup): atk_up from P1, 0 below.

buffs.label: Barrage Array: Nature Burst DMG taken
buffs.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_combo_enemy_debuff, given by the combo's Barrage Array (combo_persistentdamage aura, 180 frames = persistent_time 6 s) while the enemy stands in it: damage_up = persistent_naturalburst_increase (0.10 at level 12, P3 +0.06) on hits with decorate mask 33554432 (Arts Bursts only, of any operator). Logged as a damageTaken zone; fixtures/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json shows it only on bursts.

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable: "COMBO TRIGGER: When Typhoeus reaches max Signs."

skills.label: Basic attack 1
skills.note: durationFrames: attack2 is allowed from frame 9 (AllowNextSkillAction; SkillData durationFrame 150).

hits.label: Arrow (×2)
hits.note: Two arrows launched at frames 5 and 8; SimpleCalcBB atk_scale ÷ 2.

skills.label: Basic attack 2
skills.note: durationFrames: attack3 is allowed from frame 12 (SkillData durationFrame 182).

hits.note: One arrow, launched at frame 9; logged under attack1's projectile skill chr_0034_typhoea_attack1_01_projhit.

skills.label: Basic attack 3
skills.note: durationFrames: attack4 is allowed from frame 20 (SkillData durationFrame 185).

hits.label: First arrow wave
hits.note: 3 arrows at frames 5–8 (SimpleCalcBB atk_scale ÷ 2); one damages a given target. Several targets can take more.

hits.label: Second arrow wave
hits.note: 3 arrows at frames 14–17, as the first wave.

skills.label: Basic attack 4
skills.note: durationFrames: attack5 is allowed from frame 27 (SkillData durationFrame 170).

hits.label: First arrow
hits.note: SimpleCalcBB atk_scale_1 = atk_scale × 0.35, launched at frame 5.

hits.label: Volley arrow (×5)
hits.note: SimpleCalcBB atk_scale_2 = atk_scale × 0.13, launched at frames 15, 18, 21, 24, 27.

skills.label: Basic attack 5 (final strike)
skills.note: durationFrames: attack1 is allowed from frame 46 (SkillData durationFrame 150).

hits.note: One arrow launched at frame 22: attack5_01_projhit on a hit, or attack5_02_projhit on every target in range when the arrow is blocked (mask 2097280: Final Strike).

skills.label: Power attack
skills.note: durationFrames: battle and combo skills are allowed from frame 40 (SkillData durationFrame 180). Not yet seen in a log; the power_attack_projhit hit on reach (literal ×4, mask 132) is left out.

hits.note: The projectile (launched at frame 38) casts attack5_01_projhit with this skill's blackboard; no event key, since attack5's arrow uses that key too and this hit hasn't been logged. Unverified.

skills.label: Battle skill: take flight (opening volley)
skills.note: Enters the floating stance (kit buff hovering, at frame 0). durationFrames: floating_attack1 is allowed from frame 26 and cast automatically at frame 32 (SkillData durationFrame 40).

hits.label: First arrow
hits.note: normal_skill_attack1_projhit launched at frames 2–5: SimpleCalcBB atk_scale × 0.5 (mask 256, battle skill). The hovering buff is created at frame 0, so it's on both arrows.

hits.label: Second arrow
hits.note: normal_skill_attack2_projhit launched at frames 7–10, atk_scale × 0.5.

skills.label: Aerial basic attack 1
skills.note: Floating shots use the battle skill's level but deal basic-attack damage (damageDecorateMask 128). The shot consumes 1 Hunting Arrow at frame 1 if there is one (Power Shot; kit: slot arrow_1). durationFrames: the next shot is allowed from frame 18 (SkillData cancel frame; durationFrame 160 holds 5 direction variants).

hits.label: Power Shot arrow
hits.note: floating_attack1_01_projhit: atk_scale_total = atk_scale_base × atk_scale_enhence (talent 1 sets atk_scale_enhence 1.2/1.4/1.6; P1 ×1.2 on atk_scale_base). Shots 2–4 cast the same projectile skill with their own (equal) values.

hits.label: Power Shot Nature Burst
hits.note: Standard Nature burst × damage_enhence = potential_damage_rate (P5 1.1), × enchence_burst_damage_rate (1.3 at level 12) when the arrow consumed a Nature infliction. With the log key buff_common_natural_natural_triggered_typhoea this matches 3 bursts each in fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json and zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49.json and 2 in zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json (t=9860, 11237, both with enchence_burst_damage_rate), but dbaee's other 5 are 4–21% above it (t=8391 ×1.2134, 14084 ×1.0813, 15129–16501 ×1.0435): they need a third buff_equipsuit_spellburst_01_physpellup (Arts Intensity +16) where BuffData caps it at max_stack 2, which the log checker follows, so the key is left off until that's explained. Consuming gives 1 Sign (the engine consumes all stacks, so this counts each consumed stack) and the burst 1 more (talent 1). The consumption's usp_recover energy isn't granted: it only happens on consumption, which a kit hit's energy can't express.

skills.label: Aerial basic attack 2
skills.note: As floating_attack1 (cancel frame 18); a Power Shot when Hunting Arrow slot 2 is filled.

skills.label: Aerial basic attack 3
skills.note: As floating_attack1 (cancel frame 18); a Power Shot when Hunting Arrow slot 3 is filled.

skills.label: Aerial basic attack 4
skills.note: As floating_attack1 (cancel frame 28); a Power Shot when Hunting Arrow slot 4 is filled.

skills.label: Aerial basic attack 5 (final strike)
skills.note: The 5th shot of a hover: as the controlled operator always a Power Shot that doesn't consume Hunting Arrows (its FinishBuff of arrow_num is disabled), and a Final Strike (mask 2101376). It ends the floating stance at frame 15. durationFrames: SkillData exclusiveFrame 35 (no cancel window).

hits.label: Power Shot arrow
hits.note: floating_attack5_01_projhit: atk_scale_base (1.0 at level 12, P1 ×1.2) × atk_scale_enhence, launched at frame 0.

hits.label: Power Shot Nature Burst
hits.note: As floating_attack1's burst.

skills.label: Combo skill
skills.note: durationFrames: the battle skill is allowed from frame 48 (SkillData durationFrame 241). At frame 35 she gains usp energy (ObtainCostAction) and converts her Signs to Hunting Arrows (buff_chr_0034_typhoea_common_func_arrowreload).

hits.label: First arrow
hits.note: combo_01_projhit (launched at frame 35): SimpleCalcBB atk_scale ÷ 7. Its hit spawns the Barrage Array. The cast uses up all 8 Signs (requires); 8 Signs at 2 Signs per arrow (energy_to_bullet_ratio 2) give 4 Hunting Arrows, the most she can hold (all four slots). usp: 10 at level 12.

hits.label: Arrow (×6)
hits.note: combo_02_projhit, atk_scale ÷ 7.

hits.label: Barrage Array tick (×18)
hits.note: combo_persistentdamage ability entity spawned by the first arrow's hit: ChannelingAction every 1/3 s, up to 18 ticks (atk_scale_persistent ÷ 18) while the target stays inside; the first tick lands with the arrow (fixtures/zmdlogs-bdf223db8e49.json t=12171).

skills.label: Combo skill (floating)
skills.note: The combo cast in the floating stance (the stance's ChangeSkillAction swaps it in): same arrows, refreshes the stance (resets the ABATK attempts) and returns to it from frame 57 (SkillData durationFrame 70). Both combos log under the same event keys. At frame 35: usp energy and the Sign conversion. The game shares one cooldown between the two combos; the timeline doesn't.

hits.label: First arrow
hits.note: As combo_skill's first arrow (frame 35). The stance buff is created at frame 0; applied here with the first arrow.

skills.label: Ultimate
skills.note: Spawns the arrow rain (chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill_arrowrain) at frame 61, which multiplies atk_scale_main/center/outer by potential_damge_up (P5 1.2) and passes them on, and gives arrow_num_given Hunting Arrows at frame 61. Enters the floating stance. durationFrames: floating shots are allowed from frame 83 (SkillData durationFrame 92).

hits.label: Arrow rain, main hit
hits.note: ultimate_skill_arrowrain (damage at the entity's frames 1–3). Matches fixtures/zmdlogs-dbaee23b801d.json t=13975 (103923, crit), but fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json t=4415 (15716, P0, no logged buffs) is ×1.1585 above it, unexplained, so no event key. Hunting Arrows: arrow_num_given is 2 at every level (slots 1–2); P5 adds 1, which a fixed gain can't follow (assumed 2). The stance buff is created from frame 0; applied here.

hits.label: Hail of Arrows tick (4 rains × 3)
hits.note: buff_chr_0034_typhoea_ultimate_skill_cause_subarrowrain (5 s) spawns a Hail of Arrows when one of her next ABATKs hits (damage tags of the floating shots), up to 5 times: 4 × ultimate_skill_arrowrain_sub1 (3 ticks of atk_scale_outer ÷ 3 at entity frames 6–15) then 1 × sub2. Needs those 5 shots within 5 s; when they land depends on the shots, so these have no frames (they count from the ultimate's start).

hits.label: Empowered Hail of Arrows tick (×5)
hits.note: ultimate_skill_arrowrain_sub2: atk_scale_2 = atk_scale_center × 0.08 at entity frames 6–21. Seen only in fixtures/zmdlogs-d9e59d0fb737.json (t=13829–14675), whose missing buff hides the absolute value: no event key.

hits.label: Empowered Hail of Arrows blast
hits.note: ultimate_skill_arrowrain_sub2: atk_scale_1 = atk_scale_center × 0.6 at entity frames 30–33. d9e59's implied multipliers 0.3017 (×5) and 2.2629 are 7.50 apart, as 0.6/0.08. Unverified.

skills.label: Plunging attack (landing)
skills.note: SkillData durationFrame (no earlier cancel window found). Not yet seen in a log.

hits.note: DamageAction at frames 0–4 (mask 1152); plunging_attack_end_projhit is an alternative landing hit with the same value. Unverified.
